name: Monodicalcium phosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound composed of equal proportions of dicalcium phosphate and monocalcium phosphate.

name: Alfalfa, dehydrated, protein < 16% dry matter
description: Dehydrated aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.), containing less than 16% protein (in dry matter).

name: Zinc sulfate heptahydrate RG
description: Zinc sulfate heptahydrate is the hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula ZnSO4·7H2O). This product is of reagent quality.

name: Dicalcium phosphate anhydrous
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaHPO4. It is one of the main calcium phosphates used in animal feeding.

name: Oat hulls
description: Outer envelopes of the oat grain (Avena sativaL.) and byproduct of oat processing.

name: Zinc carbonate RG
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula ZnCO3. It is a white crystalline solid or powder that is insoluble in water. This product is of reagent quality.

name: Cottonseed, whole, extruded
description: Extruded whole seed of cotton (Gossypiumspp.). Other name: full-fat cottonseed.

name: Sodium molybdate dihydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula Na2MoO4·2H2O. It is one of the main sources of supplemental molybdenum.

name: Oats, flaked
description: Flaked or rolled oat grain (Avena sativaL.).

name: Selenium methionine
description: Methionine and selenium complex used as a source of organic selenium. These products have a variable selenium content.

name: Magnesium sulfate heptahydrate RG
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound (salt) with the formula MgSO4·7H2O. This product is of reagent quality. Other names: epsomite, Epsom salt. Alternative spelling: magnesium sulphate heptahydrate (UK).

name: Millet, proso
description: Grain of proso millet (Panicum miliaceumL.). Other names: common millet, broomtail millet, hog millet, white millet, broomcorn millet.

name: Monoammonium phosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula NH4H2PO4. Other name: ammonium dihydrogen phosphate.

name: Common vetch
description: Seed of common vetch (Vicia sativaL.), a grain legume.

name: Tallow
description: Slaughterhouse byproduct consisting of heat-treated fat trimmings from cattle and other ruminant livestock, obtained before the carcass is split.

name: Citrus pulp, fresh
description: Fresh byproduct of the processing of citrus fruit (Citrusspp.) for juice production or canning. It consists principally of the pulp and can include the skin and the pips. The orange (Citrus×sinensis(L.) Osbeck) is the main cultivated species.

name: Maize bran
description: Byproduct of flour or grits manufacture from maize grain (Zea maysL.). It consists principally of outer skins, some germ fragments, and endosperm particles. Maize bran is an extremely variable product. Other name: corn bran (USA).

name: Cobalt sulfate heptahydrate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CoSO4·7H2O, which is one of the most commonly available salts of cobalt. Alternative spelling: cobalt sulphate heptahydrate (UK). Other name: cobalt(II) sulfate heptahydrate.

name: Pea
description: Seed of pea (Pisum sativumL.). Pea is one of the main grain legumes worldwide, and some varieties are grown for animal feeding.

name: L-threonine
description: L-threonine obtained by fermentation from carbohydrate sources.
